name_zh: 参考值语料库与数字化服务（sha256 锚定 / 带容差 / 可被 pytest 直接消费）
evidence_basis: 9 reference tables digitised with two independent transcription passes; max pointwise relative difference 3.93e-05 against a 1e-3 gate (artifacts/reference_corpus/corpus_audit.json)
every entry carries source + sha256 anchor + tolerance (with coverage factor k) + validity_range; jsonschema Draft 2020-12 validation with zero errors
serving is fail-closed: one flipped bit in an archived artefact refuses the entry (9/9 parametrised pytest cases; API returns 409 INTEGRITY_REFUSED)
values are served by monotone PCHIP; PCHIP-vs-linear deviation 5.43e-04 <= 1e-3, so the tabulated grids are dense enough for linear reading too

each table carries an independent numerical verification block (finite difference for the beam ODE, adaptive quadrature for the Pasternak Hankel integral, Bessel-zero residual for the cylinder mode, deep-water limit for the sloshing dispersion), all rel. errors <= 6.2e-06
corpus-driven re-adjudication of delivered Wave-8 nodes: W8-N07 ITTC-1957 anchor upgraded from self-referential to anchored (0.00%), W8-N02 sloshing modes 1-3 at 0.42/0.43/0.45% vs a 3% gate

pytest.command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_reference_corpus.py tests/test_reference_api.py -q

withheld: Abramson (1966) / Faltinsen (2000) nonlinear resonant amplitude and sloshing impact-pressure tables (no scan in repo)
Riska / FSICR ice-load coefficient tables (rulebook revision not archived in repo)
Kerr (1964) viscoelastic foundation creep tables (material constants unavailable offline)
limits: sha256 anchors the in-repo digitisation artefact, not a page image of the source document
the two digitisation passes are two independent transcription programs, not two human keyers; human double-keying remains an open item
first batch is ANALYTIC/FITTED provenance only: no MEASURED reference table is served yet
12 of 102 Wave-8 acceptance items could not be classified beyond NO_STATUS because the node artefacts do not carry a pass/verdict field
